Buying a home? Don't skip the inspection action plan.

The Homebuyer Inspection Action Kit helps you:
- Read your inspection report like a pro
- Prioritize repairs by cost + urgency
- Negotiation scripts for credits vs repairs
- Red-flag checklist (foundation, roof, electrical)
- Post-closing maintenance calendar
